answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the grove of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the haven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
